why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Read the Host GPUs guide Start with the Host GPUs guide , which the docs describe as the way to join the network as a GPU provider.
2 Step 2 : Follow the Ubuntu setup instructions The docs list system setup and hosting instructions for Ubuntu. Work through them before you try to host.
3 Step 3 : Look at the Solana wallet page The docs include a Solana wallet setup page .
4 Step 4 : Use the troubleshooting page if setup fails The docs keep a troubleshooting page for common hosting issues and their fixes.
5 Step 5 : Look at the Nosana network explorer Open the Nosana network explorer to see general activity on the network.
